about: Hand grades for judged benchmark parts, keyed by part id (as shown on eval/renders/index.html). Each entry: {"grade": "match" | "minor" | "feature_wrong" | "different", "why": "..."}, the same four bands the judge scores on; match and minor pass. Used by `python -m eval.judge calibrate` (threshold + band agreement). Fill in from the review page's 'Copy labels JSON' button.

gemini-3.5-flash-lite/lib26-cdabac/rag/h.why: This structure is missing back support for the stand, meaning that it would likely fail.

gemini-3.5-flash-lite/lib26-cdabac/rag/p.why: Grooves were too deep, covering 50% of the entire geometry.

gemini-3.5-flash-lite/lib26-cdabac/norag.why: The tube is not 90 degrees. The end of the tube is cut off along on axis, rather than flush with the curvature.
Did not specify centering of the combs, so this design fits the specification as written.

gemini-3.5-flash-lite/lib26-cdabac/rag/h.why: The walls appear to be larger than 2mm, without any real measurements.

gemini-3.5-flash-lite/lib26-cdabac/rag/m.why: The keyhole shape is missing, and is instead a simple slot.

gemini-3.5-flash-lite/lib26-cdabac/rag/h.why: There appears to be no straight edges, the tub appears to be 90 degrees.

gemini-3.5-flash-lite/lib9/norag/m05/rep.why: Six slots are required, this only features 1 slot.

gemini-3.5-flash-lite/lib9/norag/h02/rep.why: The base and back are not connected. There is no back support for the phone.

gemini-3.5-flash-lite/lib26-cdabac/norag.why: The gussets are incorrectly offset. The second gusset is not even on the L bracket.
The flap is unsupported and likely to break when used. The geometry is irregular, and it is not clear how this would be used as a stand.

gemini-3.5-flash-lite/lib26-cdabac/rag/p.why: No tick marks. This is borderline different object because of the lack of all but one tick mark.
